6.1.m: 53. In the Mahākāla forest, description of the māhātmya of the sacred ford named Sundara; description of the māhātmya of the Piśācamocana sacred ford; narration of the story of the twice-born Devala there. 55.2 / 54. Description of the māhātmya of the Nīlagaṅgā. 57.1

6.1.s: 55 revājalanimagnāṃ bhūmiṃ dṛṣṭvā taduddhārārthamagastyena vindhye tapaścaraṇam, tattapaḥprasannāyā vindhyavāsinyā ujjayinyāṃ gamanam, vindhyavāsinīvimalodatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam...... 57 2
6.1.d: 55 रेवाजलनिमग्नां भूमिं दृष्ट्वा तदुद्धारार्थमगस्त्येन विन्ध्ये तपश्चरणम्, तत्तपःप्रसन्नाया विन्ध्यवासिन्या उज्जयिन्यां गमनम्, विन्ध्यवासिनीविमलोदतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्...... 57 2
6.1.m: 55. Seeing the earth submerged under the waters of the Revā, Agastya performs austerity on the Vindhya mountain for its rescue; pleased with his austerity, Vindhyavāsinī goes to Ujjayinī; description of the māhātmya of the Vindhyavāsinī and Vimaloda sacred fords. 57.2

6.1.s:
56 māṃdhātṛkṣetrarudrasaromāhātmyavarṇanam, kṣātāsaṃgamatīrthavarṇane sūryānusūryayorvivāhā
nantaraṃ yamayamunayorutpattivarṇanam, kṣātāsaṃgamatīrthamāhātmyama.. .. .. 58 2
6.1.d:
56 मांधातृक्षेत्ररुद्रसरोमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, क्षातासंगमतीर्थवर्णने सूर्यानुसूर्ययोर्विवाहा
नन्तरं यमयमुनयोरुत्पत्तिवर्णनम्, क्षातासंगमतीर्थमाहात्म्यम.. .. .. 58 2
6.1.m: 56. Description of the māhātmya of the Rudrasaras in the Māndhātṛ sacred field; in the description of the Kṣātāsaṅgama sacred ford, description of the birth of Yama and Yamunā after the marriage of Sūrya and Anusūryā; māhātmya of the Kṣātāsaṅgama sacred ford. 58.2

6.1.s: 57 gayātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra gayātīrthapraśaṃsāyāṃ tuhuṇḍarākṣasapīḍitānāṃ sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ brahmāgre gamanama, brahmādibhirviṣṇuloke gatvā viṣṇustavanakaraṇam, viṣṇvanujñayā sarveṣāṃ gayātīrthe gamanam ... .... -. -.. -... 60 1
6.1.d: 57 गयातीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र गयातीर्थप्रशंसायां तुहुण्डराक्षसपीडितानां सर्वेषां देवानां ब्रह्माग्रे गमनम, ब्रह्मादिभिर्विष्णुलोके गत्वा विष्णुस्तवनकरणम्, विष्ण्वनुज्ञया सर्वेषां गयातीर्थे गमनम् ... .... -. -.. -... 60 1
6.1.m: 57. Description of the māhātmya of the Gayā sacred ford; there, in the praise of the Gayā sacred ford, all the gods afflicted by the rākṣasa Tuhuṇḍa go before Brahmā; Brahmā and the others go to the world of Viṣṇu and offer praise to Viṣṇu; by the command of Viṣṇu, all go to the Gayā sacred ford. 60.1
58. Description of the māhātmya of the śrāddha rites performed with mantras and according to injunction at the Gayā sacred ford. 60.2

6.1.d: 59 गयाक्षेत्रस्थफल्गुनदीमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, आदिगयाबुद्धगयाविष्णुपदीगयाकोष्ठगदाधरवेदिकाऽक्षयवट प्रेतमुक्तिकरीशिलाऽच्छोदादितीर्थेषु स्नानदानफलमाहात्म्यम्, तत्र ऋषिपत्नीनारदसंवादे नारदेनर्षिपञ्चमीव्रतमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्.... 62 1
6.1.m: 59. Description of the māhātmya of the Phalgu river situated in the Gayā sacred field; the fruit and māhātmya of bathing and donating at Ādigayā, Buddhagayā, Viṣṇupadī, Gayākoṣṭha, Gadādharavedikā, Akṣayavaṭa, Pretamuktikarīśilā, Acchodā, and other sacred fords; there, in the dialogue between the sage's wife and Nārada, Nārada describes the māhātmya of the Ṛṣipañcamī observance. 62.1

6.1.s: 60 puruṣottamamāhātmyavarṇane ddhyakṣṇīnārāyaṇasaṃvādaprasaṃgena malamāsamāhātmyavarṇanam, adhimāse vrataniyamādividhividhānakathanam, malimlucamāse snānadānādimāhātmyavarṇanam-...... ...... 62
6.1.d: 60 पुरुषोत्तममाहात्म्यवर्णने द्ध्यक्ष्णीनारायणसंवादप्रसंगेन मलमासमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, अधिमासे व्रतनियमादिविधिविधानकथनम्, मलिम्लुचमासे स्नानदानादिमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्-...... ...... 62
6.1.m: 60. In the description of the Puruṣottama māhātmya, in the course of the dialogue between Lakṣmī and Nārāyaṇa, description of the māhātmya of the intercalary month; explanation of the rules and injunctions for observances and disciplines in the additional month; description of the māhātmya of bathing, donating, and other acts in the intercalary month. 62

6.1.s: 61 adhimāse mahākālavanavāsamāhātmyam, puruṣottamapūjākramamāhātmyam, jaṭeśvaramaheśvaratīrthasnānamāhātmyama, bhārgavarāmatīrthamāhātmyama , kauśikīnadīmāhātmyam, adhimāse snānadānādimāhātmyavarṇanam............ 64 1
6.1.d: 61 अधिमासे महाकालवनवासमाहात्म्यम्, पुरुषोत्तमपूजाक्रममाहात्म्यम्, जटेश्वरमहेश्वरतीर्थस्नानमाहात्म्यम, भार्गवरामतीर्थमाहात्म्यम , कौशिकीनदीमाहात्म्यम्, अधिमासे स्नानदानादिमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्............ 64 1
6.1.m: 61. Māhātmya of dwelling in the Mahākāla forest during an intercalary month; māhātmya of the order of worship of Puruṣottama; māhātmya of bathing in the Jaṭeśvara and Maheśvara sacred fords; māhātmya of the Bhārgavarāma sacred ford; māhātmya of the Kauśikī river; description of the māhātmya of bathing, donating, and other acts in an intercalary month. 64.1
62. Māhātmya of the Gomatīkuṇḍa; māhātmya of Kāśī; description of obtaining the meritorious fruit of bathing and other acts in the Gomatīkuṇḍa. 64

6.1.s: 63 kanthaḍeśvarakhagartāsaṃgamavīreśvaravāmanatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra balipīḍitairdevairbrahmalokaṃ gatvā sarvabalivṛttanivedanam, brahmaṇā viṣṇorārādhanārthamupāyakathanam, tatra brahmadevendrādidevasaṃvādaprasaṃgena viṣṇusahasranāmakathanam, sahasranāmaphalaśrutikathanam, vāmanāvatārādikuṇḍasthāpanavṛttāntamāhātmyavarṇanam. -.. 65 1
6.1.d: 63 कन्थडेश्वरखगर्तासंगमवीरेश्वरवामनतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र बलिपीडितैर्देवैर्ब्रह्मलोकं गत्वा सर्वबलिवृत्तनिवेदनम्, ब्रह्मणा विष्णोराराधनार्थमुपायकथनम्, तत्र ब्रह्मदेवेन्द्रादिदेवसंवादप्रसंगेन विष्णुसहस्रनामकथनम्, सहस्रनामफलश्रुतिकथनम्, वामनावतारादिकुण्डस्थापनवृत्तान्तमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्. -.. 65 1
6.1.m: 63. Description of the māhātmya of the Kanthaḍeśvara, Khagartāsaṅgama, Vīreśvara, and Vāmana sacred fords; there, the gods afflicted by Bali go to the world of Brahmā and report all of Bali's conduct; Brahmā explains the means for propitiating Viṣṇu; there, in the course of the dialogue between Brahmā and Indra and the other gods, recitation of the thousand names of Viṣṇu; narration of the declaration of the fruits of the thousand names; narration of the establishment of the pool of the Vāmana incarnation and others, and description of its māhātmya. 65.1
64. Description of the Vīreśvara and Kālabhairava sacred fords; narration of the Bhairavāṣṭaka hymn there. 70.2
65. In the context of the Nāgālaya sacred ford, the story of Janamejaya and Āstīka; description of the māhātmya by demonstrating the names of the nine pools; māhātmya of the Ramāsaras sacred ford. 71
66. Description of the māhātmya of the Nṛsiṃha sacred ford, preceded by the narration of the story of the birth of Nṛsiṃha. 72.2
67. In the description of the māhātmya of Kuṭumbeśvara, description of the practice of austerities by Dakṣa, Mahādeva, and others. 72.2

6.1.s: 68 devaprayāgatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam, ānandabhairavatīrthamāhātmyam, akhaṇḍeśvaratīrthavarṇane brahmadattasya mahāpāpino'pi tatra maraṇādbrahmalokaprāptivarṇanam, nāradabrahmasaṃvāda-prasaṃgenākhaṃḍasarastīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam-. ..... 73 2
6.1.d: 68 देवप्रयागतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, आनन्दभैरवतीर्थमाहात्म्यम्, अखण्डेश्वरतीर्थवर्णने ब्रह्मदत्तस्य महापापिनोऽपि तत्र मरणाद्ब्रह्मलोकप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, नारदब्रह्मसंवाद-प्रसंगेनाखंडसरस्तीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्-. ..... 73 2
6.1.m: 68. Description of the māhātmya of the Devaprayāga sacred ford; māhātmya of the Ānandabhairava sacred ford; in the description of the Akhaṇḍeśvara sacred ford, description of Brahmadatta attaining the world of Brahmā through dying there, though he was a great sinner; in the context of the dialogue between Nārada and Brahmā, description of the māhātmya of the Akhaṇḍasaras sacred ford. 73.2
69. Māhātmya of the Karkarāja sacred ford; description of the Vidhūmrārcis sacred ford; description of the fruits of the Cāturmāsya. 74.1

70. Māhātmya of the Bindusaras and Ramyasaras sacred fords; orderly enumeration of names following the counting of the sacred fords; recitation of the sequence of pilgrimages to all the sacred fords including the pilgrimage to the deities within the city. 75.1
71. Description of the declaration of the fruit of the Avantīkṣetra māhātmya; description of the conclusion of the text. 77.1
